battle.name: 日俄戰爭
battle.brief: 日俄戰爭中的旅順之戰，緣起於俄日帝國在遠東與滿洲的競爭，日軍於一九〇四年包圍並攻取俄軍要塞。此役俄軍步兵及後備單位仍保有別丹步槍；別丹步槍早在一八六六年便正式列裝，是日俄戰爭前既有的俄制裝備。

kit.name: 別丹步槍
kit.history: 別丹步槍於一八六六年成為俄軍制式步槍，配發步兵連，負責一般步兵射擊；其後雖逐步被新式步槍取代，仍退居俄軍後備與防衛裝備之列。

countries: 日俄戰爭由日本帝國與俄國帝國在1904年2月8日清晨對旅順外港的魚雷襲擊拉開序幕，日本於翌日正式宣戰。主戰場在滿洲南部與朝鮮半島北部，依次形成鴨綠江、岫岩、營口、遼陽、旅順及瀋陽周邊的陸戰正面；海上戰線則圍繞旅順封鎖、黃海和對馬海峽的制海權交錯。戰事至1905年5月對馬海戰才使海陸局勢定案，9月5日簽訂樸次茅斯條約；南薩哈林仍有殘餘戰鬥至夏末，因此軍事收尾與條約日期並不相同。
countriesEn: The Russo-Japanese War opened with the Imperial Japanese Navy's torpedo attack on the outer harbor of Port Arthur in the early hours of 8 February 1904, followed by Japan's formal declaration of war the next day. The principal land theater lay across southern Manchuria and northern Korea, with successive fronts around the Yalu River, Hsimucheng, Pulantien, Liaoyang, Port Arthur, and Mukden. The maritime struggle was interwoven with the blockade of Port Arthur and the contest for command of the Yellow Sea and the Tsushima Strait. The Battle of Tsushima in May 1905 settled the wider naval situation, the Treaty of Portsmouth was signed on 5 September, and residual fighting continued on southern Sakhalin into late summer, so the military conclusion and the diplomatic conclusion did not fall on the same day.
people: 日本方面的軍事中樞以參謀本部長大山巖為核心，東鄉平八郎統率聯合艦隊；陸軍的黑木忠勝指揮第一軍，奧大侯指揮第二軍，野口疊指揮第三軍，畑壽六指揮第四軍，野津極指揮第五軍，其中第五軍於1904年7月接管旅順圍城。俄方最初由小尼古拉大公任滿洲總司令，1904年9月改由阿列克謝耶夫接掌，比德爾林擔任參謀長；亞歷山大·斯捷潘諾維奇·卡尼亞斯? No. The Russian commanders included General Alekseyev, who succeeded Grand Duke Nicholas in command of the Manchurian Army in September 1904, and General von Bilderling as chief of staff. Admiral Stepan Osipovich Makarov commanded the Pacific Squadron until the loss of Petropavlovsk on 31 March, General Stoessel commanded the Port Arthur garrison until its surrender, and Admiral Zinovy Rojdestvensky led the Baltic expedition. Vice Admiral Nikolai Nebogotov commanded the cruiser division destroyed or captured at Tsushima. These appointments placed long-range naval planning, fortress defense, and the direction of the Manchurian armies in separate hands, making liaison between them a persistent difficulty during the campaign.
peopleEn: On the Japanese side, General Yamagata Aritomo headed the General Staff, and Admiral Togo Heihachiro commanded the Combined Fleet. On land, Kuroki Tamemoto led the First Army, Oku Yasukata the Second, Nogi Maresuke the Third, Hata Shōroku the Fourth, and Nozu Michitsura the Fifth; the Fifth Army assumed command of the siege of Port Arthur in July 1904. On the Russian side, Grand Duke Nicholas Nikolaevich first commanded the Manchurian Army and was succeeded in September 1904 by General Alekseyev, with General von Bilderling as chief of staff. Admiral Stepan Osipovich Makarov commanded the Pacific Squadron until the loss of Petropavlovsk on 31 March, General Stoessel commanded the Port Arthur garrison until its surrender, and Admiral Zinovy Rojdestvensky led the Baltic expedition. Vice Admiral Nikolai Nebogotov commanded the cruiser division destroyed or captured at Tsushima. These appointments placed long-range naval planning, fortress defense, and the direction of the Manchurian armies in separate hands, making liaison between them a persistent difficulty during the campaign.
kits: 日軍步兵主要使用三〇式6.5公厘步槍，五發彈匣便於快速射擊；炮兵配備1902年列裝的四一式75公厘野戰砲，攻城序列另有八九式120公厘重迫擊砲與後送重砲。俄軍以莫辛－納甘特M1891步槍、7.62公厘Maxim機槍、M1891式152公厘砲、120公厘要塞砲及二八公分重榴彈砲為主力，旅順的海岸與要塞火力也使用Canet大口徑砲。海軍方面，日軍的三笠型戰列艦以伊予、朝日、敷島三艦配有305公厘主砲，富士型亦已服役；俄軍則有戰列艦Oslyabya、Retvizan、Varyag與巡洋艦Novik等較早型武裝。雙方均部署水雷、魚雷艇、軍用電話、野戰電報與無線電。日軍在遼陽繳獲的俄軍152公厘重砲及後續攻旅順時取得的重火砲，改善了原本重砲不足的限制；這些武器均在本戰爭開始前已列裝。
kitsEn: Japanese infantry primarily carried the Type 30 6.5 mm rifle, whose five-round magazine permitted rapid fire. Their artillery included the Type 41 75 mm field gun, adopted in 1902, while the siege inventory contained the Type 89 120 mm heavy mortar and heavy guns brought forward for the operations. The Russian Army relied on the Mosin-Nagant Model 1891 rifle, the 7.62 mm Maxim machine gun, Model 1891 152 mm guns, 120 mm fortress guns, and 28 cm heavy howitzers; Canet heavy guns also formed part of the coastal and fortress artillery at Port Arthur. At sea, the Japanese battle line included the Iyo, Asahi, and Shikishima, all of the Mikasa class and armed with 305 mm guns, as well as the earlier Fuji-class ships. Russia fielded such vessels as the battleships Oslyabya, Retvizan, and Varyag and the protected cruiser Novik. Both sides used mines, torpedo boats, field telephones, military telegraph, and wireless equipment. Russian 152 mm guns captured at Liaoyang, together with heavy artillery recovered during the siege of Port Arthur, eased the Japanese shortage of heavy fires; all these weapons had entered service before the war began.
tactics: 2月8日，日軍魚雷艇隊夜襲旅順外港，擊沉俄軍戰列艦Sevastopol，並重創Petropavlovsk；日軍雖先取得海上主動，卻未強行攻港。2月28日，黑木第一軍渡過鴨綠江，在成川與俄軍東滿鐵路守備隊交戰；3月初，奧大侯第二軍由皮子窩登陸，向南切斷旅順通往營口、瀋陽的鐵路。4月30日，野口第三軍在大石橋擊敗俄軍騎兵，5月初第一軍經反覆攻擊奪取岫岩，兩軍遂分別向遼陽和旅順展開。5月26日日軍夜襲旅順因俄軍射擊與陣地阻擋而失敗，日軍改採重砲壓制、坑道爆破和逐段奪取高地的辦法，6月15日占領二百零三公尺高地；圍城部隊經數月炮擊與封鎖，終於在11月30日迫使斯托埃塞爾投降。8月下旬的遼陽會戰中，日軍以第一、第二軍正面施壓，第三軍從俄軍右翼迂迴，9月初占領遼陽。1904年9月至1905年2月的瀋陽會戰則由日軍連續攻勢與俄軍冬季反擊交替構成，直到日軍奪取城郊關鍵陣地，俄軍才向北撤退。5月對馬海戰中，東鄉以較快航速拉開射程，派驅逐艦分隊逼近施放魚雷，主力艦隊則反覆橫越俄軍戰列線；涅博戈托夫分隊受創後投降，使俄國遠征艦隊喪失返回旅順的可能。
tacticsEn: On 8 February, a Japanese torpedo-boat force attacked Port Arthur at night, sinking the Russian battleship Sevastopol and damaging Petropavlovsk. Although Japan gained the initiative at sea, it did not force an immediate assault on the harbor. On 28 February, Kuroki's First Army crossed the Yalu River and fought the Russian guards of the Chinese Eastern Railway around Seongshan. In early March, Oku's Second Army landed at Pitzuwo and advanced south to cut the railway linking Port Arthur with Pulantien and Mukden. On 30 April, Nogi's Third Army defeated Russian cavalry at Tashihchiao, while the First Army captured Hsimucheng after repeated attacks in early May. The two armies then converged toward Liaoyang and Port Arthur. A Japanese night assault on Port Arthur on 26 May was checked by Russian fire and defensive positions, so the Japanese shifted to massed heavy artillery, saps, controlled demolition, and the gradual seizure of commanding ground. They took the 203-metre Hill on 15 June, and after months of bombardment and blockade, Stoessel surrendered on 30 November. During the fighting around Liaoyang in late August, the First and Second Armies pressed the Russian front while the Third Army turned their right flank, leading to the occupation of Liaoyang in early September. The battle around Mukden from September 1904 to February 1905 alternated between Japanese attacks and Russian winter counteroffensives. Russian withdrawal north followed the loss of the decisive positions around the city. At Tsushima in May, Togo used the greater speed of the Japanese fleet to extend firing range, sent destroyer divisions in for torpedo attacks, and repeatedly crossed the Russian line of battle. After the cruiser division under Nebogotov was damaged and offered to surrender, the Russian expedition lost any practical route back to Port Arthur.
data: 本錄日期以公曆為準；俄方原始文書常用俄曆，同一事件可能相差十三日。1904年2月8日先有旅順魚雷襲擊，2月9日才宣戰；3月皮子窩登陸的關鍵是切斷旅順、大連、營口、海龍州至瀋陽的鐵路，因旅順守軍的主要補給依賴營口方向。遼陽戰役始於8月24日，旅順於11月30日陷落，瀋陽方面俄軍於1905年2月19日撤離，對馬海戰則自5月14日延續至5月28日。羅日捷文斯基的遠征支隊於1904年12月15日自利巴維啟航，核心作戰序列包括三艘戰列艦、四艘巡洋艦、十艘驅逐艦與六艘魚雷艇，另有武裝運輸船護送；全隊繞好望角橫越大西洋與太平洋，航程約一萬六千海里，1905年3月16日抵達長崎。遠航雖沿途取得煤炭補給，但老舊鍋爐、航速與燃料限制使俄艦難以在接戰前保持有利狀態。日軍則利用朝鮮至鴨綠江、遼東與旅順的接連補給網，並以船運第五軍及重砲。各役傷亡統計因陣亡、失蹤、戰俘、疾病及收治日期口徑不同而有明顯差異，本錄不把估算硬寫成單一精確數字。
dataEn: Dates here follow the Gregorian calendar; Russian records originally used the Julian calendar, so the same event may appear thirteen days earlier in Russian documents. The torpedo attack on Port Arthur occurred on 8 February 1904, and the declaration of war followed on 9 February. The March landing at Pitzuwo was intended to cut the railway running through Port Arthur, Dalny, Pulantien, and Hsiung-yueh to Mukden, because the garrison at Port Arthur depended chiefly on supplies moving through the Pulantien corridor. The Battle of Liaoyang began on 24 August, Port Arthur fell on 30 November, and the Russian forces withdrew from the Mukden sector on 19 February 1905. The Battle of Tsushima lasted from 14 to 28 May. Rojdestvensky's expedition left Libau on 15 December 1904. Its core order of battle included three battleships, four cruisers, ten destroyers, and six torpedo boats, accompanied by armed transports. The voyage around Cape Horn across the Atlantic and Pacific covered roughly 16,000 nautical miles, and the fleet reached Nagasaki on 16 March 1905. Although coal was obtained along the route, old boilers, limited speed, and fuel restrictions made it difficult for the Russian ships to enter battle in favorable condition. Japan sustained its forces through a connected supply network running from Korea to the Yalu, Liaodong, and Port Arthur, while shipping the Fifth Army and heavy artillery to the same theater. Casualty totals vary according to the treatment of the dead, missing, prisoners, disease, and the dates on which wounded were recorded, so this account does not present contested estimates as exact figures.
cause: 衝突源於日本與俄國在朝鮮、滿洲及遼東的戰略利益重疊。俄國於1896年取得中東鐵路修築權，1898年取得遼東半島租借權後，在旅順設防並開發大連港；這些安排兼具門戶與軍港作用，使俄國能把西伯利亞鐵路、滿洲資源和海軍基地連成一體。日本認為俄國在鴨綠江以北的部署威脅朝鮮，並使俄軍可沿南滿鐵路支援朝鮮，因此要求俄軍後撤、限制其在滿洲的活動；俄方則希望維持朝鮮的完整現狀、保全租借權與既有鐵路承諾，並尋求共同承認彼此在亞洲的勢力範圍。1903年的會談未能消除歧義，日本遂於1904年1月底提出最後通牒。1902年英日同盟提高了日本的外交安全，但該條約並非對俄開戰的共同承諾。2月6日兩國斷絕外交關係，2月8日日軍先攻旅順，2月9日正式宣戰，顯示東京已把軍事先制與外交程序分開處理。
causeEn: The conflict arose from overlapping Japanese and Russian strategic interests in Korea, Manchuria, and Liaodong. Russia obtained the right to build the Chinese Eastern Railway in 1896 and leased the Liaodong Peninsula in 1898, after which it fortified Port Arthur and developed Dalny. These arrangements joined a Siberian railway, resources in Manchuria, and a naval base into one strategic system. Japan regarded Russian deployments north of the Yalu as a threat to Korea and as a means of supporting Russian influence there through the South Manchurian Railway. Japan therefore demanded a Russian withdrawal and restrictions on Russian activity in Manchuria. Russia sought to preserve the existing territorial arrangement in Korea, protect its lease and railway commitments, and obtain mutual recognition of regional spheres of influence. Negotiations in 1903 failed to resolve the differences, and Japan delivered a final ultimatum in late January 1904. The Anglo-Japanese Alliance of 1902 increased Japan's diplomatic security, although it was not a joint commitment to wage war against Russia. The two governments severed diplomatic relations on 6 February. Japan attacked Port Arthur on 8 February and declared war on 9 February, showing that Tokyo had separated the military initiative from the final diplomatic steps.
impact: 戰爭首先改變了雙方的戰術與後勤。日軍以師級色帶、部隊標誌及集中重砲解決遠距指揮和識別問題，並把鴨綠江、鐵路車站與海上卸載點串成連續補給鏈；旅順攻勢則證明現代堡壘不能只靠正面突擊，必須結合封鎖、壕溝、坑道和大口徑砲火。俄軍在旅順的固守一度有效，但遼陽與瀋陽的指揮協調、鐵路調度及野戰兵力控制未能抵擋日軍的側翼攻勢。對馬海戰則讓各國重新評估裝甲艦航速、主砲射程、編隊速度與煤彈補給；英國海軍因此更重視高速全重砲 warships，但英國建造主力艦亦受英國自身戰略、海軍部觀察與財政因素影響，不能把決定歸因於單一戰例。俄國的軍事挫折與財政負荷成為1905年革命爆發的重要背景之一。亞洲局勢則轉向日本控制朝鮮並取得滿洲的鐵路、港口與租借權，俄國在東亞的戰略位置大幅後退，也留下日後條約與勢力範圍爭端的根源。
impactEn: The war first changed the tactics and logistics of both sides. Japan used divisional colored bands, unit flags, and concentrated heavy artillery to address long-distance command and unit identification, while linking the Yalu, railway stations, and coastal unloading points into a continuous supply chain. The operations against Port Arthur demonstrated that modern forts could not be reduced to frontal assault alone and required blockade, trenches, saps, and heavy fires. Russian resistance at Port Arthur was effective for a time, but command coordination, railway movement, and field control of troops failed to withstand Japanese flanking operations at Liaoyang and Mukden. Tsushima prompted a reassessment of armored ship speed, gun range, formation speed, and coal and ammunition endurance. The British Royal Navy consequently placed greater emphasis on fast all-big-gun warships, although British capital-ship policy also reflected British strategy, Admiralty observations, and finance and cannot be attributed to a single battle. Russian military defeat and the fiscal burden of the war formed an important part of the background to the Revolution of 1905. In Asia, Japan obtained control over Korea and acquired railway, port, and leasehold interests in Manchuria. Russia's strategic position in East Asia receded sharply, leaving later disputes over treaties and spheres of influence.
result: 軍事結果由三個關鍵事件構成：旅順守軍於1904年11月30日投降，野口疊接受斯托埃塞爾的交城文件；俄軍在瀋陽會戰失敗後於1905年2月向北撤退，放棄了遼陽至奉天一帶的主要陣地；5月對馬海戰則使羅日捷文斯基率領的大部分俄國波羅的海艦隊被擊沉、俘獲或失去返航能力。1905年9月5日，雙方在美國新罕布什爾州樸次茅斯簽訂條約。俄國承認日本在朝鮮的宗主地位，把遼東半島與旅順的租借權及俄方在滿洲的鐵路與讓渡權利交給日本，並將北緯50度以南的南薩哈林割讓；日本則取得南滿洲鐵路與中東鐵路的相關權益，俄軍依約撤退，條款沒有戰爭賠償。條約簽署後，南薩哈林仍有日俄部隊交火至1905年夏末，顯示主要戰役結束、條約成立與最後殘餘戰鬥止息是三個不同階段。
resultEn: The military outcome was defined by three decisive events. The garrison of Port Arthur surrendered on 30 November 1904, when Nogi accepted Stoessel's surrender document. After defeat in the Mukden fighting, the Russian army withdrew north in February 1905 and abandoned its principal positions between Liaoyang and Mukden. In May, the Battle of Tsushima sank, captured, or otherwise disabled most of the Baltic force led by Rojdestvensky and ended its prospect of returning to Port Arthur. On 5 September 1905, the two governments signed the Treaty of Portsmouth in New Hampshire. Russia recognized Japan's predominant interests in Korea, transferred its lease of Liaodong and Port Arthur and its railway and concessionary interests in Manchuria to Japan, and ceded southern Sakhalin south of 50 degrees north. Japan obtained the associated interests in the South Manchurian Railway and the Chinese Eastern Railway, while Russia agreed to withdraw its troops. The settlement included no war indemnity. Fighting continued between Japanese and Russian forces on southern Sakhalin after the treaty was signed, into the summer of 1905, demonstrating that the end of the principal campaigns, the conclusion of the treaty, and the cessation of the last residual fighting were distinct stages.
